result.summary: Several layout and content issues: restaurant names and category chips are clipped, search placeholder is misspelled, and the last popular-item card is cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol…) is truncated on the right; the name and image are cut off instead of wrapping or showing a peek of the next card.
issues.suggestion: Give horizontal cards enough padding/width, or use consistent card sizing with a visible overflow hint so names and images are not clipped.

issues.description: The bottom 'Popular right now' pizza card is cut off by the tab bar, hiding the restaurant name, delivery info, and most of the image.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset so content can scroll fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped on the right (Healthy is cut, next chip is only a sliver) with no clear scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add fade/peek of the next chip or a chevron so users know the row is scrollable, and avoid cutting labels mid-character.

issues.description: Search placeholder is misspelled as 'Restarants' instead of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.
